mixture_note: Professional proportions sum to 100 within the new pool. Future training mixture is 70% professional / 30% immutable Stage4A replay, subject to a separate authorized training design. No historical data copied into teacher requests.
seed_policy: Finite original family-disjoint seed pool; expand only for observed coverage deficits or failure modes. Record attempts, accepted rows, rejected rows and review coverage. No promised thousands or acceptance-rate-driven weakening.

split_policy.assignment: Deterministic hash of frozen split salt and connected-component family ID before teacher generation; whole group assigned to one split.
split_policy.small_pool_rule: Use a preregistered explicit family assignment to ensure validation/test exist; never split a family or pretend a tiny holdout is a reliable generalization estimate.
split_policy.evaluation_access: Test reference artifacts are sealed from training teachers and curriculum tuning. Evaluation judge receives generated artifact and visible evidence, not historical test answers.
split_policy.near_duplicate_audit: Normalize text, check exact hashes and token-shingle similarity; inspect cross-split near matches, union connected families and resplit before release.
